title: 第855章 杀了沈云翔第854章 从了他
slug: 领证爽约我转嫁你哥哭什么
content_zh:
他身高跟沈云翔差不多，一米八几的个子，身形和脸型长得也极为相似，只是站在那便让人感到十足的压迫感。
手下被吓得脸色突变：“二爷……”
“滚出去！”
沈景辞沉声，透着股厉色。
手下一句话都不敢说，急忙低着头离开。
林蔓心底一闪而过的颤抖，总觉得他现在变得有点令人畏惧。
但很快，她便被恨意取代。
“看来今天挺开心啊。”
沈景辞目光扫了眼桌上被吃完的外卖盒子，一步一步来到铁架床边，居高临下睨着林蔓。
那眼神像是毒蛇的信子一样缠绕在林蔓的肩颈。
瞬间，一股寒气弥漫林蔓全身。
难道他知道什么了？
林蔓心口一抖，表面上依然维持着镇定：
“那到底我是吃还是不吃呢？”
林蔓冷笑一声，不去看他的眼睛。
沈景辞也不恼，俯下身，抬手捏着她的下巴，迫使她与自己对视。
“怎么？听到他们说沈云翔来找你，很激动？是不是觉得自己很快就能从这里离开了？”
林蔓咬着牙冷冷道：“沈景辞，我跟云翔结婚了，你这么做到底有什么意义？”
“意义？”
沈景辞冷呵了一声，“意义就是，你能重新回到我的身边！”

他太偏执了。
疯狂得让林蔓觉得可怕。
林蔓一字一字道：
“当初是你结束了那段我们从未开始的感情，严格点来说，我们从来都没在一起过，谈什么回到你的身边？”
林蔓句句都是讽刺。
沈景辞锋利的剑眉拧紧，咬着后槽牙，颇为不满。
“你真是一直想方设法都想从我这里离开，难道跟我在一起不开心吗？”
“老三有什么好的？一个无能之辈！
你想要沈家的一切，我夺下来，拱手给你啊！”
沈景辞周身遍布戾气，那股子疯狂透着张扬，仿佛沈家是他唾手可得的东西。
林蔓心里咯噔一下，难以置信地看着他：“你想干什么？”
沈景辞突地嗤出声笑：“你还真是聪明啊，这么快就想到了。”
他压低声音，嗓音沙哑到了极致。
“知道吗？老大一直都看他不顺眼。”
“这不？你失踪的时候，老三想跟老大作对嘛，那我就给个顺水人情，帮他喽。”
沈景辞发出咯咯的笑声，那笑冷得像是冬天里的冰碴子。
他直起身，张开手臂，仿佛在拥抱他的江山，笑得癫狂。
content_en:
He is about the same height as Chen Yunxiang, about 1.8 meters tall, and his body shape and face are very similar. Just standing there makes people feel quite oppressive.
The subordinates were so frightened that their expressions suddenly changed: "Second Master..."
"Get out!"
Shen Jingci said in a deep voice, with a stern look on his face.
The men didn't dare to say a word and hurriedly left with their heads lowered.
Lin Man felt a flash of trembling in his heart, feeling that he had become a bit intimidating now.
But soon, she was replaced by hatred.
"It seems like you are very happy today."
Shen Jingci glanced at the eaten takeout boxes on the table, walked step by step to the iron frame bed, and looked down at Lin Man.
The look in his eyes wrapped around Lin Man's shoulders and neck like a poisonous snake's letter.
Instantly, a chill filled Lin Man's body.
Does he know something?
Lin Man's heart trembled, but he still maintained his composure on the surface:
"Then should I eat it or not?"
Lin Man sneered and didn't look into his eyes.
Shen Jingci was not annoyed. He leaned down and raised his hand to pinch her chin, forcing her to look at him.
"What? Are you excited when you heard them say that Chen Yunxiang came to see you? Do you think you can leave here soon?"
Lin Man gritted his teeth and said coldly: "Shen Jingci, Yun Xiang and I are married. What's the point of doing this?"
"Meaning?"
Shen Jingci snorted coldly, "The meaning is that you can come back to me again!"
He's too paranoid.
It was so crazy that Lin Man felt terrible.
Lin Man said word by word:
"It was you who ended the relationship that we never started. Strictly speaking, we have never been together. Why are we talking about coming back to you?"
Lin Man's every sentence is sarcastic.
Shen Jingci tightened his sharp eyebrows and gritted his back molars, feeling quite dissatisfied.
"You are really trying every possible way to leave me. Aren't you happy being with me?"
"What's good about the third child? He's an incompetent person!
Everything you want from the Shen family, I will take it away and give it to you! "
Shen Jingci's whole body was full of hostility, and it was crazy and flamboyant, as if the Shen family was something he could easily get.
Lin Man's heart skipped a beat and she looked at him in disbelief: "What do you want to do?"
Shen Jingci suddenly laughed: "You are really smart, you thought of it so quickly."
He lowered his voice, making it hoarse to the extreme.
"You know? The boss has always disliked him."
"Isn't that right? When you disappeared, the third child wanted to go against the boss, so I will give him a favor and help him."
Shen Jingci chuckled, his smile as cold as ice in winter.
He straightened up, opened his arms, as if embracing his country, and smiled wildly.
